thread:
mika: Heads-up — console enabled routePriorityV2 on canary yesterday. We started seeing SDKs surface a slightly different header encoding.

arjun: I noticed errors in Go shim: it fails to parse route header that's now base64-URL encoded. Looks like py-sdk started sending `X-Redwood-Route` with new format.

ben: error logs:
```
ERROR: invalid route header: unexpected token at position 12
route: eyJwcm... (truncated)
```

kelsey: This will break some internal proxies that expect comma-separated priorities. What's the compatibility plan?

mika: Proposal: SDKs add a backwards-compatible accept header. python/ts/go should send both legacy `X-Route-Priority` (csv) and `X-Route-Priority-V2` (b64url) when feature-flag env var is set. Console toggles the flag per-tenant.

sarah: +1. Telemetry concern: quota attribution splits when both headers present and batching merges requests. We'll need to tag sampled traces so we can reconcile billing.

arjun: Suggest adding `x-redwood-route-migration: v2-optin` as telemetry tag so console and billing can filter. Also add metric `route.migration.v2.count`.

ben: Implementation notes for py-sdk: add env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_PRIORITIZE_V2=1` default off. When true, send both headers, with v2 last so server prefers it. Small patch; add unit test for parsing both, and integration test with local proxy.

kelsey: Go SDK will need explicit struct change; watch for reflection-based router code that assumes csv. I'll prepare a patch that serializes legacy csv and new b64url and keeps same ordering.

mika: Rollout plan: 1) Merge SDKs behind opt-in env var. 2) Deploy console flag UI (canary 5% tenants) that sets env var for managed workloads. 3) Monitor `route.migration.v2.*` metrics for 48h. 4) If stable, increase to 25% then 100% over 1 week. Rollback: console can clear flag.

sarah: For billing/console: hide behavioral change until we confirm quota is still attributed correctly. If we detect >0.5% attribution divergence, rollback.

devex-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for py-sdk 1.3.2-canary and go-sdk 0.9.8-canary :rocket:

arjun: One more: update SDK docs + migration guide. Add small snippet:
```
# opt-in
export REDWOOD_ROUTE_PRIORITIZE_V2=1
```

mika: I'll own rollout coordination + slack pings. kelsey/arjun please signal when PRs are ready. Thanks.

ben: I'll add a lint rule to flag code that parses `X-Route-Priority` assuming CSV. helps catch hidden breakage.

kelsey: PRs opened: py-sdk#432, go-sdk#210, ts-sdk#811 (wip). I'll link in thread as they land.

arjun: linking proxy test harness: https://github.internal/redwood/route-harness

mika: cool. follow-ups: add a console toggle audit log entry and a small notice in migration docs. :white_check_mark:
